notes_for_editor: Brief record checked: the Association county list gives Amelia Denaro at 37.24910, -77.99065, status Gone, which matches the brief. The Denaro point is about 9 km south of the Amelia Tower Site (37.33242, -77.98437), a different registered site. The story keeps them apart, as does the existing us-va-amelia record. Nothing read ties a Denaro tower to a named structure or a build date. Wikipedia is used only for the place. No staffing, fire or present-day site evidence was found, so none is stated and access is not set. Confidence low.
